data.body:
[P1] Preserve the durable context across backoff completion

When another durable thread remains active, this wait can complete in-process on a polling/checkpoint thread. The continuation then calls `executeRetryLoop()`, which immediately reads thread-local context via `DurableContext.requireCurrentContext()`; that context is not attached on the completion thread, so the retry fails with `IllegalStateException` instead of starting the next attempt. Resume the continuation through an SDK context-aware executor that restores the child durable context and logical thread state, or explicitly capture and restore both before executing the next attempt. Add an integration test with a retry backoff and a concurrently running sibling operation.
